acceptance: Loading of the code skill in the Claude Code harness on Sonnet is reported for the four prompt kinds with no hook.
The gate outcome is recorded: closed with no build, or owner go-ahead quoted.
If built: the hook is committed under deployment/, its test shows one reminder per session and fail-open on error, and the with-hook loading rate and near-miss count are reported against the gate.
If built: a sandbox session in the ablation runner shows the hook does not fire there.
Ledger total is 30 USD or less.
context: Existing result folders: ~/.tractable/finding-drafts/skill-sync-skills/2026-11-15-ablation-eval/phase2/ and .../phase3/ (private, not committed).
description: Problem: the code-first rule works only in omp. Claude Code sessions (the most used harness for Sonnet main sessions in the owner's logs) get no prompt to load the code skill. Whether Claude Code loads the skill unprompted has not been measured at all: the trigger evaluation ran in omp only. Outcome: a measurement of code-skill loading in Claude Code and, only if it is low and the owner wants it, a PreToolUse hook that does what the omp rule does. Decision gate: first measure the explicit, implicit, contextual and near-miss prompts in the Claude Code harness on Sonnet with no hook. If the skill loads in at least 50% of explicit and implicit sessions, close with the result and build nothing. Otherwise put the numbers to the owner; build the hook only on the owner's go-ahead. Adopt it only if it raises loading to at least 80% of sessions that edit source and fires in 0 near-miss sessions. Guardrails: (1) agents under test run only in /tmp/omp-ablation sandboxes through evals/ablation/run.py or the loading-map probe, and through replay.py only after replay-disable-user-rules is merged; (2) change nothing under ~/.omp/agent, ~/.claude or ~/.agents while sessions run, upgrade neither omp, Claude Code nor tractable-mcp during a run, and start no run while another evaluation is running; (3) commit the pre-registration (hypothesis, arms, checks, sample, decision, Holm family and alpha) before any scored session; smoke runs never count; (4) use a new out folder and a ledger with the ceiling stated here; stop at the ceiling and report; raising it needs the owner's approval in a later message; (5) record the omp, Claude Code and tractable-mcp versions with the results; never pool new sessions with results from another harness version; new comparisons form their own Holm family and published bands are left unchanged; (6) existing scenarios and pre-registration files are not edited: new arms use new scenario ids and a new pre-registration file, and run.py report or phase3_bands.py over the existing result folders gives the same output before and after; (7) read at least 5 transcripts per arm before reporting any number, and report grader faults found; (8) delete or weaken no instruction or skill text on this evidence; (9) a published number in a report is never rewritten: add a dated note after it; (10) scenario and scratch code that produced a result is committed with it; (11) if a result changes a claim in the blog post 'Testing agent instructions', correct the draft by PR; if the post is published, open a PR that adds a dated correction note and updates its 'updated' time, and merge it only after the owner approves in a later message, because a merge to main of joeharris76.com deploys the public site; (12) publish by task branch and draft PR with identity Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>; the item stays open until its PR is merged through the repository's usual flow (green CI, squash merge), and anything this item reserves for the owner is not merged or installed without the owner's message. Spend ceiling 30 USD. Extra: a hook is added to the user's Claude Code settings only after the owner approves the measured result; the hook must give one reminder per session, must not block or alter the edit beyond that, must fail open if it errors, and must not run in the ablation runner's Claude Code sandbox.
